explanation: Asserts that every graph with chromatic cardinal ℵ_1 has a subgraph with chromatic cardinal ℵ_1 that is infinitely edge-connected: deleting any finite edge set leaves it connected. This matches Thomassen [Th17], whose abstract states that every graph of uncountable chromatic number has a subgraph with uncountable chromatic number and infinite edge-connectivity. A subgraph of a χ = ℵ_1 graph with uncountable χ has χ exactly ℵ_1, so the formulation is faithful. erdosproblems.com/1067 currently says Thomassen 'constructed a counterexample to the version which asks for infinite edge-connectivity', which conflicts with Thomassen's abstract. The page wording appears to be in error, and the Lean statement (answer yes) agrees with the original paper.
